findings.summary: Acceptance criterion 'Directly exercise all 13 tool routes against the service, including their required validation guards' is unmet: the only service test asserts the 13 tool names returned by list_tools(); no test invokes any tool to verify route, method, or payload forwarding, and none exercises required-parameter or validation guards (idempotency_key, expected_revision, and the other mandatory fields). The seal-verified verification record (make verify, exit 0, 716 passed) confirms tests pass, but the required route-exercise and validation-guard tests do not exist in the product tree.

Acceptance criterion 'the new endpoint is reachable after start' is not demonstrated: no test starts the server and probes the /mcp endpoint; only the pre-start bind check port_is_available(DEFAULT_PORT) is asserted, so post-start HTTP reachability of the 13 tools is unproven.
